ecology_question: Among historically documented Macaronesian vascular-plant losses, how much independent island-level replication actually exists for the same species after excluding global, archipelago-wide and taxonomically uncertain records?

strict_response.count: number of unique species x named island well-supported island-level loss records, with raw record count separately
strict_response.archived_author_total: Original paper abstract records 168 records, 126 taxa, 13 global and 155 local records (known prior art, not a new Structural result).

outcomes_to_freeze.per_category_counts: all four author declared category labels and other labels if present; no post-outcome recoding
outcomes_to_freeze.certainty_counts: all category evidence labels and missingness
outcomes_to_freeze.well_supported_island_level_events: actual count of author well-supported island-level extirpations
outcomes_to_freeze.repeated_distinct_islands_per_species: number species with 2+ different island-level confirmed loss island names
outcomes_to_freeze.cross_archipelago_replication_per_specie: number species with 2+ different archipelagos with well-supported island-level losses
outcomes_to_freeze.per_archipelago_and_island_counts: summary only where number of identified events; no direct observed dispersal
outcomes_to_freeze.last_observation_dates: counts of parseable year; not known true time of extinction
outcomes_to_freeze.pollination_and_dispersal: descriptive source categories only, not new trait cause

necessary_go_conditions_for_future_test: At least 2 archipelagos with >0 well-supported island-level loss events
Historically present species × island risk-set denominator independently available for both loss and persistence; S1 only has observed losses
True species-specific remaining island population identity observed at time before each loss if testing source/rescue
Extinct globally and locally cannot be conflated or time-leaked into baseline
Study-level evidence not duplicated through taxonomic synonyms or repeated source records
No use of S2 'N local and global extinction events' as predictor (outcome leakage)
decision: If S1 cannot supply a valid complete species × island at-risk denominator, classify positive count patterns as audit/descriptive, not extinction risk or source rescue effect; do not open S3/S4 to rescue a favorable result without separate prior contract.
